entries.title: Fixed Oval Track and Pivoted Cabin Carrier
entries.description: One newly authored complete static oval-track amusement-carrier exterior. Two grounded whole A-frames and low cross-ties support a full central horizontal axle. The axle enters a long rigid vertical spine carrying separate upper and lower end-wheel shafts. Two whole stadium-shaped guide bands consist of actual straight long sides joined to semicircular ends; two independent open end wheels with complete spokes and hubs lie inside those return ends. Eight whole empty framed cabins have their own transverse track pivots, low thick open pans, four posts, roofs and front crossbars. This is not a circular Ferris wheel scaled into an ellipse: there is no central radial-spoke wheel or single circular rim; two separate end-wheel centres, a continuous long carrier spine and straight guide runs establish a different complete structure. Nor is it a twin-arm ride with one transverse passenger tray. All new numeric geometry, no old frame, wheel or cabin extracted or transformed. One complete compact display model at explicit 0.75 design scale, zero scenes, four opaque PBR appearances, metres Z up, horizontal bounds-centred and four finite full feet on ground. Empty fixed exhibition pose only. Guide bands are solid visual track members, not an articulated or validated chain. No movement, rolling engagement, passenger restraint, capacity, fit, loading, manufacture, ride operation or safety is built or certified; no rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Whole Road Machines and Open Trench Yard
entries.description: One static road-machine display yard, one scene and zero new independent models. Three complete qualified machines retain unit scale and every original local position/normal/index buffer, material dictionary and internal hierarchy: the whole grader spans a genuine shallow long floor recess with all six whole tyre soles supported on the two side decks; the whole tracked paver is quarter-turned in the rear left bay and the whole single-drum roller stays separately in the forward left bay. A broad open middle strip and front apron separate the intact machines. One closed scene-only slab has a real lowered recess bottom and four inner walls, not a dark decal or a cap at deck level. This is not the old excavator behind entrance barriers, nor the flat aviation ground-service holding corner. The initial plain three-machine parking idea was rejected before any source because its spatial relation was too similar. No old model is extracted, resized, recoloured or counted anew. The recess is a shallow static display feature, not a human inspection pit or access route. No grading, paving, compaction, maintenance procedure, moving wheels or articulation, machine coupling, traffic flow, structural support capacity, human clearance, accessibility, operation, installation or safety certification. Rigging, animation and interaction are not made and outside this static scope.

entries.title: Whole Thick-Keeled Serrate-Leaf Rosette
entries.description: One complete newly authored static succulent-like rosette. Lower leaves arch outward while a few smaller inner leaves rise upright; no separate thin petioles, broad oval pads, flat alpha planes or repeated floating edge spikes. The whole fleshy longitudinal section, toothed outline and direct crown assembly differ from old inflated-stalk floating oval rosette and branching flattened paddle cactus, not merely a leaf count or color variant. One whole plant prop zero scenes. No exact aloe/agave species, medicinal use, roots, growth, cultivation, water storage performance or ecological claim.

entries.title: Fixed Inclined Channel and Weighted Pusher Card Shoe
entries.description: One newly authored complete empty static dealing-shoe-style tabletop prop. A single welded thick channel body contains a full inclined floor, high longitudinal sides, a closed rear and two low front retaining shoulders around a genuine open U finger-access recess. A full matching notched wedge base supports the entire body. Two longitudinal fixed guide rods root in the sidewalls and meet one whole shaped pusher at the rear part of the channel; a complete transverse rounded weighting roller is seated into that pusher. The front portion remains visibly empty and open for the illustrated card-extraction direction. This is not an open postal letter tray made narrower: the whole raked shoe body, retaining shoulders and fixed guided weighted pusher are new. Nor is it a banknote counter with its controls removed: no powered feed bank, stacker wheels, receiving tray or two-stage paper path is reused. All geometry newly authored, six closed editable meshes, four opaque untextured PBR roles, one prop zero scenes. Metres Z up, horizontal bounds-centred and the entire finite base sole on ground. Static empty appearance only, no cards, dealing simulation, format compatibility, roller movement, spring, counting, game rules, fairness, odds, gambling outcome, manufacturing or safe-use claim; no rigging, animation or interaction.

entries.title: Static Clothed Upright Torso And Curled Fan Tail Merfolk
entries.description: One independently authored complete static clothed merfolk fantasy character. A continuous fully covered tunic waist, upright chest, neck and human-like head rises directly from a newly drawn single broad fish lower body. The whole lower body curves down and sideways into a tapered raised tailstock and a thick complete bifurcated fan fin, with a finite low tail-underside resting patch. Two complete long-sleeved bent arms and blunt hands frame the waist; integral dark hair regions, small embedded eyes, ears and a blunt nose define a simple adult-like stylized face. All body sections, curve paths, fin outline and limb placements are new numeric geometry, not a catalog fish with a human head, the existing centaur upper body pasted onto a fish, or a horse with its legs removed. entries.title: Fixed Four Roller and Open Throat Fairlead
entries.description: One complete newly authored fixed four-roller fairlead appearance. A broad grounded mounting plate joins two rear bearing posts and an upper tie. Two complete hollow horizontal rollers on independent full transverse shafts sit behind the upright pair, leaving a genuinely open central throat with no back plate. The four rollers are depth-staggered with visible separation rather than intersecting corner cylinders. No rope or winding barrel is included. Unlike the full ratchet winch, it has no storage drum, pawl or crank; unlike the single feed-roller stand, it has a complete opposed four-boundary throat and compact mounting frame rather than height sleeve/foldout legs. New geometry only, no old mesh imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metres Z up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One static prop zero scenes. Fixed illustrative shaft roots, not a running fit. No rope guidance, roller rotation, rope compatibility, force, load, installation, manufacture, marine use or safety claim.
